decisions.reason: As a recently launched sensor module with its own page, it fits the firm's core modular sensing platform and management is likely to justify the investment by treating any weak early uptake as temporary.

Although it was only mentioned on the website and thus carries a weaker public commitment, voltage measurement is central to the firm's measurement-oriented platform so escalation of commitment still favors continuation.

This software proxy has strong strategic fit with the firm's push for richer software and connectivity, and its standalone presentation signals enough commitment to keep backing it after only one year.

Even with lower visibility than products given their own page, a CAN bus interface supports industrial communication use cases that are important to the platform, making management inclined to persist.
A carbon dioxide sensor module is a clear extension of the modular sensing range and its own product page indicates visible commitment, reducing the chance of withdrawal so soon after launch.

The touch panel accessory is somewhat more peripheral than core modules, but because it was newly launched and publicly presented as part of the ecosystem, management would likely continue it rather than reverse course quickly.
